yards_per_play.name: yards_per_play
yards_per_play.title: Yards Per Play (YPP)
yards_per_play.description: Average offensive yards gained per snap across matching plays.
yards_per_play.calculation_explained: Sum of yards_gained divided by total qualifying offensive plays (pass_attempt + rush_attempt).

epa_per_play.name: epa_per_play
epa_per_play.title: Expected Points Added / Play (EPA/play)
epa_per_play.description: Expected Points Added per offensive play from the nflfastR Expected Points model.
epa_per_play.calculation_explained: Sum of play-level EPA (Expected Points after play minus Expected Points before play) divided by total plays.

success_rate_pct.name: success_rate_pct
success_rate_pct.title: Offensive Success Rate (%)
success_rate_pct.description: Percentage of plays that achieve positive series/down success.
success_rate_pct.calculation_explained: Divides successful plays (series_success == 1 or EPA > 0) by total plays, multiplied by 100.

passer_rating.name: passer_rating
passer_rating.title: NFL Passer Rating
passer_rating.description: Official NFL Passer Rating (0.0 to 158.3 scale) based on completion %, YPA, TD %, and INT %.
passer_rating.calculation_explained: Standard NFL formula combining clamped completion %, yards/attempt, touchdowns/attempt, and interceptions/attempt.

any_a.name: any_a
any_a.title: Adjusted Net Yards / Attempt (ANY/A)
any_a.description: Passing yards per dropback adjusted for touchdowns (+20 yds), interceptions (-45 yds), and sacks.

explosive_play_rate.name: explosive_play_rate
explosive_play_rate.title: Explosive Play Rate (20+ Yds %)
explosive_play_rate.description: Percentage of offensive plays gaining 20 or more yards.
explosive_play_rate.calculation_explained: Counts plays with yards_gained >= 20 divided by total plays * 100.

screen_yards_after_catch.name: screen_yards_after_catch
screen_yards_after_catch.title: Screen Pass Yards After Catch (Screen YAC/play)
screen_yards_after_catch.description: Average yards gained after the catch on screen pass plays (air_yards <= 0 or charted screen).
screen_yards_after_catch.calculation_explained: Filters play-by-play to screen passes (is_screen == 1) and divides sum(yards_after_catch) by total screen plays.

yac_over_expected.name: yac_over_expected
yac_over_expected.title: Yards After Catch Over Expected (YACOE)
yac_over_expected.description: Average extra yards gained after catch above nflfastR's xYAC model expectation.
yac_over_expected.calculation_explained: Subtracts nflfastR xyac_mean_yardage from actual yards_after_catch and divides by completed passes.

qb_impact_score.name: qb_impact_score
qb_impact_score.title: QB Game Impact Score (0-100)
qb_impact_score.description: 0-to-100 composite score measuring how much a quarterback directly impacted the game outcome.
qb_impact_score.calculation_explained: Starts at a league-average baseline of 50.0 and adds weighted contributions from EPA/play (+18x), Win Probability Added per game (+85x), Completion % Over Expected (+0.85x), series success rate above 50% (+20x), minus turnover rate penalty (-120x), clamped to [0, 100].

qb_meaningful_win.name: qb_meaningful_win
qb_meaningful_win.title: MLB-Style QB Meaningful Win (MW)
qb_meaningful_win.description: MLB pitcher-style QB Win credited per game ONLY when the team wins AND the QB was a meaningful contributor (Game Impact Score >= 55).
qb_meaningful_win.calculation_explained: Evaluates each individual game (scope='game', agg='sum') using the custom `qb_impact_score` stat: awards +1 Meaningful Win (MW) for each game where the team wins and game `qb_impact_score >= 55.0`. Wins where the QB plays below the 55.0 impact threshold are scored as a No-Decision (ND).

qb_meaningful_loss.name: qb_meaningful_loss
qb_meaningful_loss.title: MLB-Style Inverse QB Meaningful Loss (ML)
qb_meaningful_loss.description: Inverse loss stat charged per game to a QB when the team loses AND the QB's Game Impact Score <= 42.0 materially drove the defeat.
qb_meaningful_loss.calculation_explained: Evaluates each individual game (scope='game', agg='sum') on top of `qb_impact_score`: charges +1 Meaningful Loss (ML) only when the team loses and game `qb_impact_score <= 42.0`. Losses where a QB played high-impact football (`qb_impact_score > 42.0`) are recorded as a No-Decision (ND).

screen_effectiveness_index.name: screen_effectiveness_index
screen_effectiveness_index.title: Screen Pass Effectiveness Index (SPEI)
screen_effectiveness_index.description: Composite screen-game rating combining screen yards gained, screen YAC, YAC over expected, and screen EPA.
screen_effectiveness_index.calculation_explained: Composes traditional/custom building blocks on screen plays (`is_screen == 1`): 3.5 * `yards_per_play` + 2.5 * `screen_yards_after_catch` + 4.0 * `yac_over_expected` + 25.0 * `epa_per_play`.

qb_quality_start.name: qb_quality_start
qb_quality_start.title: QB Quality Start (QS)
qb_quality_start.description: Counts games where a QB posts a 60+ Game Impact Score with zero turnovers.
qb_quality_start.calculation_explained: Evaluated per game (scope=game, agg=sum): awards 1 QS when game qb_impact_score >= 60 and turnover_rate == 0.
